View only: the aim point, Hitscan and the host's aim check never see it. All three knockback values (pitch, yaw, recover) are Shibi-approved industry defaults 2026-10-28, not DESIGN.md values. Still open: per-weapon kick (Kenney's blaster.tres is the 3-pellet weapon; blaster-repeater.tres uses the weapon.gd defaults, ~0.06-0.14 deg), ADS kick, on-device (Fold) check.

camera_knockback_pitch_deg.note: view kick up per ranged shot; Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's mid-ish pick, not a DESIGN.md value) in Kenney Starter-Kit-FPS weapons/blaster.tres pitch kick min_knockback.x-max_knockback.x 0.025-0.045 rad (1.4-2.6 deg; x = pitch, weapon.gd:18-19), which never recovers there

camera_knockback_yaw_deg.note: sideways view kick per shot, random sign each shot (Kenney random_vec2); Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's pick, not a DESIGN.md value): softer for third person than Kenney Starter-Kit-FPS weapons/blaster.tres min yaw kick, range min_knockback.y-max_knockback.y 0.025-0.04 rad (1.4-2.3 deg; y = yaw, weapon.gd:18-19)

camera_knockback_recover_s.note: linear return to rest after the latest kick; 0 turns the knockback off; Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's pick, not a DESIGN.md value) inside a ~0.2-0.35 s snappy recover band (no single named source)
